email_subject: Application – Brand Manager Intern, Nestlé Baby (Nutrition)
email_body:
Dear Nestlé recruitment team,

I'd like to apply for the Brand Manager Intern position with Nestlé Baby (Nutrition) in Brussels, starting at the end of January 2027.

I'm a digital marketer working where SEO, content and web meet. At Episto I write and publish SEO content, update pages and media in WordPress, and track results in Google Analytics and Search Console. Freelance, I build sites end to end: mirook.com went from structure to JSON-LD schema and iterative audits, and baverok.com has a hand-coded landing page and a free site-check flow. Briefs, asset follow-up and post-campaign analysis are the parts I already enjoy.

I live in Zwijndrecht, so Brussels is an easy commute, and I'm happy to work from home. English is fluent; my Dutch is at B1 writing and A2+ speaking, and I'm improving it daily.

I'd welcome the chance to talk.

Kind regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm applying for the Brand Manager Intern position with Nestlé Baby, starting at the end of January 2027 in Brussels.

What draws me to this role is the mix it asks for: content and campaigns on one side, structure and follow-up on the other. That's the work I do now. At Episto I handle on-page SEO and SEO content for client websites, publish and update pages, blog posts and media in WordPress, and read the results in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. As a freelancer I build sites from structure to launch: mirook.com went end to end, including JSON-LD schema and repeated technical audits, and I coordinate with external people and clients to get assets finished and live. I've also worked on e-commerce product pages and Shopify catalogues, so consumer-facing product content isn't new to me.

Baby nutrition is a category where the message matters as much as the product. Parents read closely, and they read on their phones. I'd like to put my digital habits behind campaigns that genuinely reach Belgian families: landing pages, e-newsletters, search visibility, and AI-assisted content production that keeps quality intact while moving faster. I'm also used to retro-planning and keeping several stakeholders aligned; at KXP I worked on large digital workplace projects for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff), where timing and accuracy weren't optional.

I'm fluent in English, based in Zwijndrecht with an easy commute to Brussels, and my Dutch is improving steadily, at B1 writing and A2+ speaking. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can support the Baby team.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
